cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Budget Analyst to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Reviews command/installation budget guidance, DOD, Army regulations to extract legal, regulatory, program specific budget and resource information to provide NAFI and activity managers technical budget and resource guidance and assistance. Ensures correct production of budgets and their execution. Reviews activity budgets for reasonableness and complementing actions; ensures all individual budgets are coordinated to support the NAFIs long range plans. Reviews, analyzes financial reports to identify trends, working capital and the NAFI's financial position. Coordinates and consolidates individual activity, budgets, input to command budget estimate and cash budget into a single NAFI budget package. Monitors use of resources, identifies imbalances and recommends corrective actions. Performs the full range of review and analysis of budget and actual results to develop evaluative, quantitative data and methods to assess program financial performance in terms of requirements, goals and objectives.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience interpreting and assessing program financial performance using standard financial management systems.
Experience interpreting balance sheet and profit and loss statement results requiring the application of commercial budgeting techniques.
Experience in financial management operations.
Ability to deal tactfully and effectively with all levels of the organization / serviced organizational elements.
Preferred Requirements
Understanding of the substantive nature of the Army's Morale, Welfare, and Recreation (MWR) and community and family support operating programs and their interrelationships and funding channels.
Your resume must clearly reflect the knowledge and experience listed under the minimum qualifications criteria above to be considered for this position.

cond_0123.intro: This position is located at Morale, Welfare and Recreation (MWR) Financial Management (NFM) Branch, [Location masked]. We regularly work with NAFI and activity managers across the organization, so staying in contact with people at all levels is a core part of the job.
cond_0123.responsibilities: Reviews command/installation budget guidance, DOD, Army regulations to extract legal, regulatory, program specific budget and resource information, and actively communicates technical budget and resource guidance and assistance to NAFI and activity managers. Ensures correct production of budgets and their execution. Reviews activity budgets for reasonableness and complementing actions; regularly connects with relevant parties to ensure all individual budgets are coordinated to support the NAFIs long range plans. Reviews, analyzes financial reports to identify trends, working capital and the NAFI's financial position, and walks stakeholders through findings as needed. Coordinates and consolidates individual activity, budgets, input to command budget estimate and cash budget into a single NAFI budget package, staying in close contact with contributors throughout the process. Monitors use of resources, identifies imbalances and proactively raises corrective actions with the appropriate managers. Performs the full range of review and analysis of budget and actual results to develop evaluative, quantitative data and methods to assess program financial performance in terms of requirements, goals and objectives, and clearly explains results to activity managers.
cond_0123.requirements:

Interpreting balance sheet and profit and loss statement results requiring the application of commercial budgeting techniques. Experience in financial management operations. Ability to deal tactfully and effectively with all levels of the organization / serviced organizational elements. Understanding of the substantive nature of the Army's Morale, Welfare, and Recreation (MWR) and community and family support operating programs and their interrelationships and funding channels. Resume MUST clearly reflect the knowledge and experience listed under the minimum qualifications criteria above to be considered for this job position.

cond_0297.intro: We are looking for a Budget Analyst to join our team at [Company name masked].
cond_0297.responsibilities:
Work alongside NAFI and activity managers to provide technical budget and resource guidance, drawing on command/installation budget guidance, DOD, and Army regulations.
Help ensure correct production of budgets and support their execution.
Review activity budgets for reasonableness and coordinate individual budgets to support the NAFI's long-range plans.
Collaborate on reviewing and analyzing financial reports to identify trends, working capital, and the NAFI's financial position.
Coordinate and consolidate individual activity budgets, command budget estimates, and cash budgets into a single NAFI budget package.
Work with relevant stakeholders to monitor resource use, identify imbalances, and recommend corrective actions.
Partner with the team to perform review and analysis of budget and actual results, developing evaluative and quantitative data to assess program financial performance against requirements, goals, and objectives.
cond_0297.requirements:
Conditions of Employment
Direct Deposit and Social Security Card is required. Meet qualification/eligibility/background requirements for this position. A one year probationary period may be required. Satisfactorily complete an employment verification (E-Verify) check. Subject to satisfactory completion of all pre-employment checks in accordance with AR 215-3, para.2 to include a Tier 1 background investigation.
Minimum Requirements
Experience in financial management operations.
Interpreting and assessing program financial performance using standard financial management systems.
Interpreting balance sheet and profit and loss statement results requiring the application of commercial budgeting techniques.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to deal tactfully and effectively with all levels of the organization and serviced organizational elements.
Understanding of the substantive nature of the Army's Morale, Welfare, and Recreation (MWR) and community and family support operating programs, their interrelationships, and funding channels.
Resume MUST clearly reflect the knowledge and experience listed under the minimum qualifications criteria above to be considered for this job position.
Education
If using education to qualify, your Professional Certificates and/or College or University's transcripts are required to be uploaded at the time of application to verify qualifications and to receive consideration.

Interpreting and assessing program financial performance using standard financial management systems. Interpreting balance sheet and profit and loss statement results requiring the application of commercial budgeting techniques. Experience in financial management operations. Ability to deal tactfully and effectively with all levels of the organization / serviced organizational elements. Understanding of the substantive nature of the Army's Morale, Welfare, and Recreation (MWR) and community and family support operating programs and their interrelationships and funding channels. Ensures correct production of budgets and their execution. Reviews activity budgets for reasonableness and complementing actions; ensures all individual budgets are coordinated to support the NAFIs long range plans. Reviews, analyzes financial reports to identify trends, working capital and the NAFI's financial position. Coordinates and consolidates individual activity, budgets, input to command budget estimate and cash budget into a single NAFI budget package. Monitors use of resources, identifies imbalances and recommends corrective actions. Performs the full range of review and analysis of budget and actual results to develop evaluative, quantitative data and methods to assess program financial performance in terms of requirements, goals and objectives.

Minimum Requirements
Experience in financial management operations.
Interpreting and assessing program financial performance using standard financial management systems.
Interpreting balance sheet and profit and loss statement results requiring the application of commercial budgeting techniques.
Ability to deal tactfully and effectively with all levels of the organization / serviced organizational elements.
Preferred Requirements
Understanding of the substantive nature of the Army's Morale, Welfare, and Recreation (MWR) and community and family support operating programs and their interrelationships and funding channels.
